Definition: , or prolongation πετάομαι, or contracted πτάομαι middle voice of a primary verb; to fly:--fly(-ing).
BiblicalUsage: Petomai means to fly, and in Revelation it is the angels who fly. One angel flies in the midst of heaven with the everlasting gospel, another flies and cries woe to the earth, and an angel calls to all the fowls that fly in the midst of heaven to gather to the great supper of God.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the flying angels show me the gospel is not crawling: it moves through the heaven itself, and every creature is summoned to hear it.
